name: Novariso
summary: Warm paper-and-espresso furniture brand site with huge tight-tracked grotesk headlines, alternating near-black bands and one copper accent.

fonts.pairing: one grotesk family: Display cut at 500 with very tight tracking for headlines, Inter for body and small uppercase labels

signature: two-tone headline where the last line switches to copper
pill buttons with a filled circular dot-icon on the left
statement band where a split headline is pushed to opposite edges of the page
near-black and paper bands alternating roughly every other section
imagery: sunlit AI-staged interiors in oat, linen and pale oak; moody dark workshop shots; square-cornered crops with no radius
layout_grid: 1136px content (1200 frame, 32px sides), 128px section padding, 12-col feel with 2/3/4-up card grids, sharp image corners, fully round pills
